remarks_1999: Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Exam. at Mr. Strand's house, Feb. 1946:. . . . No signature [note of backing inscription]. Purple petunia. Owned Mr. Jacob Strand. . . . Parke–Bernet Galleries, Inc, . . . painted 1925. Coll. Alfred Stieglitz, Jacob Strand, Paul Strand." Picture of this subject mentioned in 1934 New York (An American Place) exhibition review in *New York Times* (1934). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Petunia

description: A dark purple petunia stretches across this landscape-oriented canvas. Its center is slightly lighter than its petals. The abstract, textured background of the work is painted in shades of light purple and white. A green leaf extends from underneath the flower; it is cut off by the edge of the canvas.
